text:
Alex: starting regional rollout now: US -> EU -> APAC. canaries at 5% per region, holdpoints between region steps (15m). anyone object?
deploy-bot: deploy job queued: release/2026-03-21-rc1. initiating canary in us slice-1.
Maria: on it. dashboards/rollout-live linked: https://dash.redwood/rollouts/rc1. pulling capacity snapshot now.
ops-bot: capacity snapshot: US free GPU slots 72%, EU 59%, APAC 33%. queued requests: us=4 eu=6 apac=15.
Kai: APAC still thin on free slots. suggest applying temporary pin to the 8-bit-quant model there and bumping warm pool min by 1.
Jamal: +1 for APAC pin. what's our pin command and reason string?
Alex: `redwoodctl pin-version --model redwood-gptx --region apac --version 2026-03-20-8bit --reason "reduce mem footprint during cutover"`
Maria: running quick smoke on 8bit in staging (1m). will check tail latencies and correctness.
ops-bot: staging smoke: median +3ms, p95 +25ms, p99 +120ms, throughput -8% (within perf guardrails).
Maria: looks safe. applying APAC pin and increasing warm pool min.
deploy-bot: pin applied in apac; autoscale warm pool min+=1 for 30m. canary kicked to 5% in US (ok). EU canary pending.
Kai: adding EU soft-pin for first 5% to rc1-canary variant to limit rollout risk: `redwoodctl pin-version --model redwood-gptx --region eu --version 2026-03-21-rc1-canary --soft`
Alex: ack. note the change window in release notes: 02:00-04:00 UTC. include rollback triggers and contacts.
Jamal: rollback triggers agreed: APAC rollback if queue depth > 40 or p99 > 700ms sustained for 5m. EU rollback if thermal events / node eviction >2 in 10m. US fallback: shift 30% EU traffic to US for up to 10m if EU thermal detected.
SRE-Oncall: watching the window 03/21 02:00-04:00 UTC. will escalate at queue depth 25 or p99 500ms. ping me in #incidents if threshold crosses.
Maria: documenting this: release-notes draft will call out APAC pinned to 8bit-quant during rollout, EU soft-canary, canary percentages, holdpoints, rollback criteria, and SRE contact.
Alex: deploy-bot reports US canary stable at 5%. proceeding to expand US slice to 20% now. hold 15m before EU expand.
ops-bot: warm pool heat checks scheduled every 3m during rollout. alert threshold: warm pool CPU > 70% for 10m.
Kai: after APAC stabilizes, we'll consider unpinning to default model. plan an automated unpin task 45m post-rollout if no alerts.
Jamal: logging action items: (1) Maria update release notes and post to #release-notes, (2) Alex supervise region handoffs, (3) Kai monitor autoscale/warm pools, (4) SRE-Oncall monitor thresholds.
Alex: thanks all. will post final status in 15m. :thumbsup:
